description: Code editor with Explorer (left), Editor (center), integrated Terminal (bottom) and Command Palette.
tips: Create a file with content: ctrl+n, then ONE type_text with the complete content (it is pasted exactly, so VS Code cannot auto-close brackets or quotes). Never type content in pieces.
Save to a specific place: ctrl+s, then in the save dialog select_text on the Name field and type the FULL path, e.g. "~/Desktop/test_auto.json\n". Do not click Desktop/Home in the sidebar.
If a 'Replace?' / overwrite confirmation appears, it needs the user's approval.
After saving, the tab title shows the file name without the unsaved dot (●); the window title shows the name too.
The Command Palette (ctrl+shift+p) runs any command by name: type the command then \n.
Open a folder: ctrl+k then ctrl+o, or Command Palette 'File: Open Folder'.
Quick open a file by name: ctrl+p.
Electron UI: if elements are missing, use keyboard shortcuts and the Command Palette instead of clicking.
